title: Set 198

sentences.ko: 어젯밤에 애 재우는 데 한 시간 반은 걸렸어. 잠든 것 같아서 방에서 살금살금 나오려고 할 때마다 바닥이 삐걱거려서 애가 벌떡 일어나 앉는 거야. 그래서 겨우 잠들었을 때는 나도 너무 피곤해서 그냥 자는 것 말고는 아무것도 못 했어.
sentences.text: It took me like an hour and a half to get her down last night. Every time I thought she was out and tried to sneak out of the room, the floor would creak and she'd sit right up, so by the time she finally fell asleep, I was too tired to do anything but go to bed myself.

alts.text: Last night she took like an hour and a half to go down. Every time I thought she was out and tried sneaking out, the floor would creak and she'd pop right up, so by the time she finally crashed, I was too wiped to do anything but go to bed too.

Last night it took me approximately an hour and a half to get her to sleep. Each time I believed she was asleep and attempted to leave the room quietly, the floor would creak and she would sit up immediately, so by the time she finally fell asleep, I was too exhausted to do anything other than go to bed myself.

sentences.note: **get her down** 은 아이를 재운다는 뜻이고, 잠들었다는 건 **she was out** 이라고 해요. **sneak out of** 는 몰래 빠져나간다는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 친구가 하도 졸라서 토요일에 농구를 했거든. 할 때는 엄청 신났는데 지금은 온몸이 쑤시고 오한까지 나서 오늘은 그냥 침대에 누워 있으려고.
sentences.text: My friend talked me into playing basketball on Saturday, and I felt great while we were playing, but now my whole body aches and I've got the chills, so I think I'm just going to stay in bed today.

alts.text: My buddy dragged me out for basketball Saturday. Felt awesome while we played, but now everything hurts and I've got the chills, so I'm just staying in bed today.

A friend of mine persuaded me to play basketball on Saturday, and I felt wonderful while we were playing. However, my entire body is now aching and I have the chills, so I believe I will remain in bed today.

sentences.note: **talked me into** 는 나를 설득해서 뭔가를 하게 만들었다는 뜻이에요. **I've got the chills** 는 오한이 난다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 아, 별거 아니었어. 일주일째 귀에서 삐 소리가 나서 병원에 갔는데, 의사가 딱 보더니 그냥 귀지가 꽉 찬 거래. 그래서 귀지를 파내 줬는데 지금은 모든 소리가 엄청 크게 들려.
sentences.text: Oh, it was nothing. I went in because my ear's been ringing for a week, and the doctor took one look and said it was just full of wax. So they cleaned it out, and now everything sounds really loud.

alts.text: Nah, no big deal. My ear's been ringing for a week so I went in, and the doctor took one look and said it was just wax. They cleaned it out, and now everything's super loud.

It was nothing serious. I went to see the doctor because my ear has been ringing for a week, and after one look, the doctor said that it was simply full of wax. They cleaned it out, and now everything sounds extremely loud.

sentences.note: **it was nothing** 은 별일 아니었다고 넘길 때 써요. **my ear's been ringing** 은 귀에서 삐 소리가 계속 난다는 뜻이고, **took one look** 은 딱 한 번 보자마자라는 느낌입니다.
sentences.situation: 병원 갔다 온 얘기 가볍게 하기

sentences.ko: 내가 그렇게 들떠 있던 안마의자 기억나? 그게 거실 반을 차지하는데 한두 번 썼나 몰라. 솔직히 좀 아프거든. 주문하기 전에 매장에서 한번 앉아 봤어야 했는데.
sentences.text: Remember that massage chair I was so excited about? It takes up half the living room, and I've used it maybe twice, because honestly, it kind of hurts. I really should've tried one out in a store before I ordered it.

alts.text: You know that massage chair I was so pumped about? It takes up half the living room and I've used it like twice, because honestly, it kinda hurts. I really shoulda tried one in a store before ordering it.

Do you remember the massage chair I was so excited about? It occupies half of the living room, and I have used it perhaps twice, because, to be honest, it is somewhat painful. I really should have tried one in a store before I ordered it.

sentences.note: **takes up** 은 공간을 차지한다는 뜻이에요. **should've tried one out** 은 미리 써 봤어야 했다는 후회를 나타냅니다.

sentences.ko: 이사하는 거 정말 도와주고 싶은데, 토요일 아침에 우리 애 축구 시합이 있어서 아무래도 정오 전에는 거기 못 갈 것 같아. 그래도 일요일에 짐 푸는 거 아직 도움이 필요하면 그때 들를 수 있어.
sentences.text: I'd really like to help you move, but I've got my kid's soccer game Saturday morning, and I don't think I could get over there before noon. If you still need help unpacking on Sunday, though, I can come by then.

alts.text: Wish I could help you move, but my kid's got a soccer game Saturday morning, and I doubt I could make it over before noon. If you still need help unpacking Sunday, though, I can swing by then.

I would very much like to help you move, but I have my child's soccer game on Saturday morning, and I do not believe I could arrive before noon. However, if you still need assistance unpacking on Sunday, I would be able to come by then.

sentences.note: **get over there** 는 그쪽으로 건너간다는 뜻이고, **come by** 는 잠깐 들른다는 말이에요. 문장 끝의 **though** 는 그래도, 대신이라는 느낌을 줍니다.

reviewed: 1번 casual: the floor creaked 와 she'd pop up 의 시제가 섞여 있어서 둘 다 would 로 맞춤 (the floor would creak)
